push.title: W 3-2 vs Love To Win | You: 8.1 (12th best match performance)
push.body:
Your 12th best match performance, BellyTb1. An 8.1 that did its job.

DID WELL
+ 5 key passes, the most you've made for us. Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ You found PhogsToffees and PhogsToffees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ 0.4 over your usual. Keep the elevator going up.
+ 19 completed passes was worth +0.3. Nice bonus.
+ We beat Love To Win 3-2. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Habit to build: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes. Practice makes permanent.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Real quick: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard. Bread and butter.
- Rating came in 0.5 below what your on-ball stats earned. A little secret: Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.
- 4 misplaced passes took 0.1. Clean that up next time.
- 2 shots off target: -0.1. Practice makes permanent.

Fundamentals drill: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Biscuits fix most things. Practice fixes the rest.

Shake it off and lace up. - Coach Lasso
